buffer_allowance_basis: 2 MiB covers the 1 MiB buffered writer plus the current storage group; final root adds 33 bytes.
bound_basis: The native collector visits each input address once. The writer emits at most a 33-byte address header per address and at most 67 bytes per storage leaf (a singleton group with a full 32-byte value); grouping and integer trimming reduce this. The first storage progress count overstates the pre-storage leaf count, making the remaining-record estimate conservative.

sequence: pbinForEachLeaf defers collector.Close until sorted leaf loading returns
WriteSnapshotStream finishes and closes snapshotFile before preimageFile creation
Preimage temporary files use tx.Debug().Dirs().Tmp, already routed to the scratch volume
Existing scratch guard only removes original ETL files after all process descriptors close and recorded identities match
preimage_transition_review.limitation: Source ordering supports the upcoming cleanup opportunity; it does not prove files have already closed or provide a complete later-phase disk bound.
